target_definition.1: zero active days in the next seven days
target_definition.0: at least one active day in the next seven days
target_definition.missing: unknown outcome; never replace with 0 or 1

prediction_population: status_at_prediction == valid; do not require a known future outcome to make predictions
evaluation_population: predicted eligible snapshots with a known outcome; report unknown outcomes separately
parameter_policy: Keep the same estimator construction as the compared models; capture effective parameters and library versions at artifact creation.
fit_policy: training_dates_only; do not refit using validation or test data
preprocessing: use the two existing numeric features unchanged; reject missing features rather than invent a new preprocessing rule
decision_rule: predict 1 when the class-1 probability >= threshold

selection_basis.objective: minimize false negatives among evaluated candidates satisfying the reminder limit
selection_basis.capacity_scope: This is a teaching assumption for the validation cohort, not a verified production capacity or a guaranteed cap for later batches.

test_policy: After freezing, evaluate the saved model and fixed threshold once. Do not use test feedback to select features, refit, or tune thresholds while still calling that test independent.
